name: IndependentMapChart.support_chart_homogenization
statement: theorem support_chart_homogenization {K : Type} [CommRing K] (x a l w u0 u1 u2 u3 u4 : K) (hc : (x-a)*w=l) : w^4*(u4*x^4+u3*x^3+u2*x^2+u1*x+u0) = u4*(a*w+l)^4+u3*w*(a*w+l)^3+u2*w^2*(a*w+l)^2+ u1*w^3*(a*w+l)+u0*w^4

name: IndependentMapChart.ordinate_chart_homogenization
statement: theorem ordinate_chart_homogenization {K : Type} [CommRing K] (x a l w y z v0 v1 v2 v3 : K) (hc : (x-a)*w=l) (hy : y=v3*x^3+v2*x^2+v1*x+v0) (hz : l*z=y*w^3) : l*z=v3*(a*w+l)^3+v2*w*(a*w+l)^2+v1*w^2*(a*w+l)+v0*w^3

name: IndependentMapChart.seven_torsion_omitted_map_control
statement: theorem seven_torsion_omitted_map_control {A B : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule B] (norm : A → B) (pull : B → A) (hl : ∀ (n : Int) b, pull (n • b)=n • pull b) (hn : ∀ a, pull (norm a)=(4 : Int) • a) (a : A) (ha : (7 : Int) • a=0) : pull ((2 : Int) • norm a)=a
